name: sdlc-workflow
description: SDLC workflow plugin, one source for Claude Code and Codex: one `$wf` workflow skill (18 keys: intake, shape, design, slice, plan, implement, verify, review, handoff, ship, retro, probe, yolo, campaign, loop, status, project, docs; the intake modes are `fix`, `rca`, `investigate`, `discover`, `audit`, `hotfix`, `refactor`, `update-deps`, `ideate`, `brainstorm`, `adopt`, `optimize`, `simplify`, `task`; `loop optimize` has a gap on Codex and pi) plus consult, diataxis and study-sources, over the shared .ai/ artifacts. Requires a hooks-GA Codex CLI (verified on 0.146.0) with hooks enabled.

interface.shortDescription: One-command SDLC lifecycle ($wf), from the same tree as the Claude Code plugin
interface.longDescription: A single-source SDLC plugin that Claude Code and Codex read directly: one $wf workflow skill (18 keys: intake, shape, design, slice, plan, implement, verify, review, handoff, ship, retro, probe, yolo, campaign, loop, status, project, docs) and three independent engineering skills (consult, diataxis, study-sources), driving 9 stages with per-slice artifacts and runtime-truth verification. `loop optimize` has a gap on Codex and pi. Skill prose is host-neutral; the Codex hooks live in hooks/codex.hooks.json. Review and trust the bundled hooks before activation.
defaultPrompt: $wf status — then run the next SDLC stage for this workflow ($wf is the skill; `wf` is NOT a shell command — on Windows it opens the Firewall console).
$wf review — review the current branch across the pre-merge dimensions.
$wf intake fix — investigate and fix this failing test.
